requirements.sourceText: and at least two additional NAI courses (6 credits) such as: NAI 211 - Intro to Native Amer. Literature, Cultures & Art 3 credits; NAI 221 - Native American Peoples and Environmental Justice 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Electives

rule.manualCheck: Other elective courses may be approved at the discretion of the Director of NAIS. LAN 111 and LAN 112 are listed as Algonquian topics; confirm the section is the Algonquian language.

requirements.sourceText: Students are required to choose four electives from among NAI courses and related courses offered by other programs (12 credits). Topics will vary from semester to semester. Approved courses include: ANT 102 - What Makes Us Human? 3 credits; ANT 203 - Native Americans 3 credits; ANT 230 - Peoples of the World 3 credits; EGL 376 - The Literature of Imperialism 3 credits; EGL 378 - Contemporary Native American Fiction 3 credits; EGL 379 - Native American Texts and Contexts 3 credits; HIS 213 - Colonial Latin America 3 credits; HIS 314 - Indigenous-Settler Relations in the United States 3 credits; HIS 338 - Asian and Pacific Islanders in American History 3 credits; HIS 385 - Aztec Civilization 3 credits; HIS 386 - The Maya 3 credits; HUS 150 - Indigenous Cultures of Latin America 3 credits; LAN 111 - Uncommonly Taught Language (Elementary) I 3 credits, Algonquian; LAN 112 - Uncommonly Taught Language (Elementary) II 3 credits, Algonquian; SOC 110 - Fire Ecology,Climate Change,& Indigenous Knowledge 3 credits. Additional elective courses may be approved at the discretion of the Director of NAIS.
